name: Ken Financial Services Limited
about: Ken Financial Services Limited is a non-systemically important non-deposit taking non-banking financial company (NBFC) in India. It offers lending services for retail, small and medium enterprises, and commercial customers; and loan products and professional fee-based services. The company provides investment banking services, as well as institutional services in the areas of equities, debt, and forex. Ken Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
